basic_info.description: Charming and well maintained Cottage! Don't miss this opportunity to own a single family home at an excellent value in San Francisco's desirable Excelsior neighborhood. This property offers flexibilityenjoy it as is, or redevelop while living comfortably on-site. With potential to expand for additional square footage, add an accessory dwelling unit, or consider building upwards to capture views. The yard is a blank canvas awaiting your green thumb. Set up as a 1 bedroom, the living room is complete with a closet and could serve as a 2nd bedroom. Near many restaurants on Mission, public transit, and easy freeway access. Don't miss your chance to own your own piece of San Francisco!
